summary: MiniIOMobileFramebuffer's per-frame cost on the single running core (NAT-153: 70.7 ms, one 1125x2436 BGRA layer to the 1080x2340 panel, rec_secs on, fb_filter/threads/scale defaults): bilinear scaling of 2.53 M panel pixels in drawRows plus record(); panel mapped write-combining (VM_WIMG_WCOMB = 6 in the scH kernel's initialize_screen), surfaces cacheable, so memory type is not the cause. Host-only timing of the unchanged loops: bilinear 4.3/7.9/16.2 ms (flat/UI-like/noise), nearest 1.4-1.5 ms, memcpy 0.4 ms. Ranked levers: display-hardware scaling (removes the copy), SMP, fb_filter=0, fbscale=2, fb_threads=1, rec_secs=0, GPU rendering. Next: native run of scH + fb_filter=0 only.
